title: Has anyone else been having a weird amount of zombie/mall dreams lately?
content: For the past month or so I've been getting a ton of zombie outbreak dreams. It alway starts out as a normal day in either the mall or amusement park until people start getting infected, then eating people, etc etc. Last night was different though. I was in the mall and once again a virus had started to go around, but it seemed to come from dairy products, mainly eggs. Within a few minutes of being infected, people became increasingly gluttonous, like eating any food they could get their hands on levels of gluttonous. The mall was in a state of complete chaos, like everyone had turned into a primal-caveman-version of themselves. I then noticed that after about 5-10 minutes of being infected, they started to become violent and would go after people, eventually trying to eat them. Then from there it became a zombie dream. Anybody else having similar experiences in their mall as of lately? Not even zombie but just virus adjacent dreams?
